module.Title: Create Multiple Health States
module.Teaching: Use else if to test another condition when the first condition is false.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why is the Hurt condition checked second?
module.PredictionExplanation: Once the first condition succeeds, the remaining branches are skipped.
module.DebugPrompt: A conditional fallback branch is written else if, not else followed by parentheses.
module.RecallPrompt: Recreate the Healthy, Hurt, and Defeated branches. Use these exact identifiers: playerHealth, status. Use these exact values: 0, 75.
module.TransferPrompt: Create Full, Low, and Empty states for torchCount. Use the exact identifier status. Use these exact values: 0, 5.
module.PreviewMessage: Health can now produce three distinct states.
